train_sd3_dreambooth: run stable diffusion 3 dreambooth fine-tuning on habana gaudi for text-to-image generation
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for sd3 dreambooth training including model path dataset and optimizer settings
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a dreambooth dataset class that prepares instance and class images with prompts for fine-tuning
encode_prompt_sd3: encode text prompts using clip and t5 text encoders for stable diffusion 3 model
run_validation_inference: run validation inference generating images with a prompt and logging to tensorboard or wandb
save_model_card_hub: save a model card with training details and generated images for pushing to huggingface hub
collate_batch_examples: collate training batch examples stacking pixel values and prompts with optional prior preservation
encode_prompt_t5: encode prompts using the t5 text encoder with configurable max sequence length for sd3
encode_prompt_clip: encode prompts using clip text encoders returning prompt embeddings and pooled prompt embeddings
load_text_encoders: load three text encoders from a pretrained sd3 model path onto the accelerator device
